verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ אֵלִיָּ֨הוּ הַתִּשְׁבִּ֜י מִתֹּשָׁבֵ֣י גִלְעָד֮ אֶל־ אַחְאָב֒ חַי־ יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָמַ֣דְתִּי לְפָנָ֔יו אִם־ יִהְיֶ֛ה הַשָּׁנִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה טַ֣ל וּמָטָ֑ר כִּ֖י אִם־ לְפִ֥י דְבָרִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lî·yā·hū hat·tiš·bî mit·tō·šā·ḇê ḡil·‘āḏ ’el- ’aḥ·’āḇ ḥay- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer ‘ā·maḏ·tî lə·p̄ā·nāw ’im- yih·yeh haš·šā·nîm hā·’êl·leh ṭal ū·mā·ṭār kî ’im- lə·p̄î ḏə·ḇā·rî
verses.literal: Now Elijah the Tishbite who was among the settlers of Gilead said to Ahab As surely as the LORD the God of Israel lives before whom I stand there will be neither dew nor rain in these years except . . . at my word
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO Elias, o tisbita, dos moradores de Gileade, disse a Acabe: Vive o SENHOR Deus de Israel, perante cuja face estou, que nestes anos nem orvalho nem chuva haverá, senão segundo a minha palavra.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֥יו לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lāw lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then a revelation from the LORD came to Elijah . . .
verses.literalPt: Depois veio a ele a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:

verses.original: לֵ֣ךְ מִזֶּ֔ה וּפָנִ֥יתָ לְּךָ֖ קֵ֑דְמָה וְנִסְתַּרְתָּ֙ בְּנַ֣חַל כְּרִ֔ית אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: lêḵ miz·zeh ū·p̄ā·nî·ṯā lə·ḵā qê·ḏə·māh wə·nis·tar·tā bə·na·ḥal kə·rîṯ ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê hay·yar·dên
verses.literal: Leave here turn eastward and hide yourself by the Brook of Cherith east of . . . . . . the Jordan
verses.literalPt: Retira-te daqui, e vai para o oriente, e esconde-te junto ao ribeiro de Querite, que está diante do Jordão.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֖ה מֵהַנַּ֣חַל תִּשְׁתֶּ֑ה וְאֶת־ הָעֹרְבִ֣ים צִוִּ֔יתִי לְכַלְכֶּלְךָ֖ שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh mê·han·na·ḥal tiš·teh wə·’eṯ- hā·‘ō·rə·ḇîm ṣiw·wî·ṯî lə·ḵal·kel·ḵā šām
verses.literal: And you are to drink from the brook and I have commanded the ravens to feed you there
verses.literalPt: E há de ser que beberás do ribeiro; e eu tenho ordenado aos corvos que ali te sustentem.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ וַיַּ֖עַשׂ כִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֗לֶךְ וַיֵּ֙שֶׁב֙ בְּנַ֣חַל כְּרִ֔ית אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ way·ya·‘aś kiḏ·ḇar Yah·weh way·yê·leḵ way·yê·šeḇ bə·na·ḥal kə·rîṯ ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê hay·yar·dên
verses.literal: So Elijah did what the LORD . . . had told him and he went and lived by the Brook of Cherith east of . . . . . . the Jordan
verses.literalPt: Foi, pois, e fez conforme a palavra do SENHOR; porque foi, e habitou junto ao ribeiro de Querite, que está diante do Jordão.

verses.original: וְהָעֹרְבִ֗ים מְבִיאִ֨ים ל֜וֹ לֶ֤חֶם וּבָשָׂר֙ בַּבֹּ֔קֶר וְלֶ֥חֶם וּבָשָׂ֖ר בָּעָ֑רֶב וּמִן־ הַנַּ֖חַל יִשְׁתֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·‘ō·rə·ḇîm mə·ḇî·’îm lōw le·ḥem ū·ḇā·śār bab·bō·qer wə·le·ḥem ū·ḇā·śār bā·‘ā·reḇ ū·min- han·na·ḥal yiš·teh
verses.literal: The ravens would bring him bread and meat in the morning . . . . . . and evening and he would drink from the brook
verses.literalPt: E os corvos lhe traziam pão e carne pela manhã; como também pão e carne à noite; e bebia do ribeiro.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֛י מִקֵּ֥ץ יָמִ֖ים וַיִּיבַ֣שׁ הַנָּ֑חַל כִּ֛י לֹֽא־ הָיָ֥ה גֶ֖שֶׁם בָּאָֽרֶץ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·hî miq·qêṣ yā·mîm way·yî·ḇaš han·nā·ḥal kî lō- hā·yāh ḡe·šem bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Some time later, however . . . . . . the brook dried up because there had been no rain in the land
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, passados dias, o ribeiro se secou, porque não tinha havido chuva na terra.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֥יו לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lāw lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to Elijah . . .
verses.literalPt: Então veio a ele a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:

verses.original: ק֣וּם לֵ֤ךְ צָרְפַ֙תָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְצִיד֔וֹן וְיָשַׁבְתָּ֖ שָׁ֑ם הִנֵּ֨ה צִוִּ֥יתִי שָׁ֛ם אִשָּׁ֥ה אַלְמָנָ֖ה לְכַלְכְּלֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: qūm lêḵ ṣā·rə·p̄a·ṯāh ’ă·šer lə·ṣî·ḏō·wn wə·yā·šaḇ·tā šām hin·nêh ṣiw·wî·ṯî šām ’iš·šāh ’al·mā·nāh lə·ḵal·kə·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Get up and go to Zarephath of Sidon and stay there Behold I have commanded a widow there to provide for you
verses.literalPt: Levanta-te, e vai para Sarepta, que é de Sidom, e habita ali; eis que eu ordenei ali a uma mulher viúva que te sustente.

verses.original: וַיָּ֣קָם׀ וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ צָרְפַ֗תָה וַיָּבֹא֙ אֶל־ פֶּ֣תַח הָעִ֔יר וְהִנֵּֽה־ שָׁ֛ם אִשָּׁ֥ה אַלְמָנָ֖ה מְקֹשֶׁ֣שֶׁת עֵצִ֑ים וַיִּקְרָ֤א אֵלֶ֙יהָ֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר קְחִי־ נָ֨א לִ֧י מְעַט־ מַ֛יִם בַּכְּלִ֖י וְאֶשְׁתֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām way·yê·leḵ ṣā·rə·p̄a·ṯāh way·yā·ḇō ’el- pe·ṯaḥ hā·‘îr wə·hin·nêh- šām ’iš·šāh ’al·mā·nāh mə·qō·še·šeṯ ‘ê·ṣîm way·yiq·rā ’ê·le·hā way·yō·mar qə·ḥî- nā lî mə·‘aṭ- ma·yim bak·kə·lî wə·’eš·teh
verses.literal: So Elijah got up and went to Zarephath When he arrived at the city . . . gate there was a widow . . . gathering sticks Elijah called to her and said Please bring me a little water in a cup so that I may drink
verses.literalPt: Então ele se levantou, e foi a Sarepta; e, chegando à porta da cidade, eis que estava ali uma mulher viúva apanhando lenha; e ele a chamou, e lhe disse: Traze-me, peço-te, num vaso um pouco de água que beba.

verses.original: וַתֵּ֖לֶךְ לָקַ֑חַת וַיִּקְרָ֤א אֵלֶ֙יהָ֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר לִֽקְחִי־ נָ֥א לִ֛י פַּת־ לֶ֖חֶם בְּיָדֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·leḵ lā·qa·ḥaṯ way·yiq·rā ’ê·le·hā way·yō·mar liq·ḥî- nā lî paṯ- le·ḥem bə·yā·ḏêḵ
verses.literal: And as she was going to get it he called to her and said Please bring me a piece of bread
verses.literalPt: E, indo ela a trazê-la, ele a chamou e lhe disse: Traze-me agora também um bocado de pão na tua mão.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֗אמֶר חַי־ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ אִם־ יֶשׁ־ לִ֣י מָע֔וֹג כִּ֣י אִם־ מְלֹ֤א כַף־ קֶ֙מַח֙ בַּכַּ֔ד וּמְעַט־ שֶׁ֖מֶן בַּצַּפָּ֑חַת וְהִנְנִ֨י מְקֹשֶׁ֜שֶׁת שְׁנַ֣יִם עֵצִ֗ים וּבָ֙אתִי֙ וַעֲשִׂיתִ֙יהוּ֙ לִ֣י וְלִבְנִ֔י וַאֲכַלְנֻ֖הוּ וָמָֽתְנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer ḥay- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’im- yeš- lî mā·‘ō·wḡ kî ’im- mə·lō ḵap̄- qe·maḥ bak·kaḏ ū·mə·‘aṭ- še·men baṣ·ṣap·pā·ḥaṯ wə·hin·nî mə·qō·še·šeṯ šə·na·yim ‘ê·ṣîm ū·ḇā·ṯî wa·‘ă·śî·ṯî·hū lî wə·liḇ·nî wa·’ă·ḵal·nu·hū wā·mā·ṯə·nū
verses.literal: But she replied As surely as the LORD your God lives I have no bread only . . . a handful . . . of flour in a jar and a little oil in a jug Look I am gathering a couple of sticks to take home and prepare a meal for myself and my son so that we may eat it and die
verses.literalPt: Porém ela disse: Vive o SENHOR teu Deus, que nem um bolo tenho, senão somente um punhado de farinha numa panela, e um pouco de azeite numa botija; e vês aqui apanhei dois cavacos, e vou prepará-lo para mim e para o meu filho, para que o comamos, e morramos.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלֶ֤יהָ אֵלִיָּ֙הוּ֙ אַל־ תִּ֣ירְאִ֔י בֹּ֖אִי עֲשִׂ֣י כִדְבָרֵ֑ךְ אַ֣ךְ עֲשִׂי־ לִ֣י מִ֠שָּׁם עֻגָ֨ה קְטַנָּ֤ה בָרִאשֹׁנָה֙ וְהוֹצֵ֣אתְ לִ֔י וְלָ֣ךְ וְלִבְנֵ֔ךְ תַּעֲשִׂ֖י בָּאַחֲרֹנָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·le·hā ’ê·lî·yā·hū ’al- tî·rə·’î bō·’î ‘ă·śî ḵiḏ·ḇā·rêḵ ’aḵ ‘ă·śî- lî miš·šām ‘u·ḡāh qə·ṭan·nāh ḇā·ri·šō·nāh wə·hō·ṣēṯ lî wə·lāḵ wə·liḇ·nêḵ ta·‘ă·śî bā·’a·ḥă·rō·nāh
verses.literal: Do not be afraid Elijah said to her Go and do as you have said But first make me a small cake of bread from what you have and bring it out to me Afterward make some for yourself and your son
verses.literalPt: E Elias lhe disse: Não temas; vai, faze conforme à tua palavra; porém faze dele primeiro para mim um bolo pequeno, e traze-mo aqui; depois farás para ti e para teu filho.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹה֩ אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כַּ֤ד הַקֶּ֙מַח֙ לֹ֣א תִכְלָ֔ה וְצַפַּ֥חַת הַשֶּׁ֖מֶן לֹ֣א תֶחְסָ֑ר עַ֠ד י֧וֹם תִּתֶּן יְהוָ֛ה גֶּ֖שֶׁם עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl kaḏ haq·qe·maḥ lō ṯiḵ·lāh wə·ṣap·pa·ḥaṯ haš·še·men lō ṯeḥ·sār ‘aḏ yō·wm tit·tɛn ha·šêm ge·šem ‘al- pə·nê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh
verses.literal: for this is what the LORD the God of Israel says The jar of flour will not be exhausted and the jug of oil will not run dry until the day the LORD sends rain upon the face of the earth
verses.literalPt: Porque assim diz o SENHOR Deus de Israel: A farinha da panela não se acabará, e o azeite da botija não faltará até ao dia em que o SENHOR dê chuva sobre a terra.

verses.original: וַתֵּ֥לֶךְ וַתַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה כִּדְבַ֣ר אֵלִיָּ֑הוּ וַתֹּ֧אכַל הוּא־ וָהִיא וּבֵיתָ֖הּ יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·leḵ wat·ta·‘ă·śeh kiḏ·ḇar ’ê·lî·yā·hū wat·tō·ḵal hū- wå̄·hī ū·ḇê·ṯāh yā·mîm
verses.literal: So she went and did according to the word of Elijah and there was food every day for Elijah and the woman and her household
verses.literalPt: E ela foi e fez conforme a palavra de Elias; e assim comeu ela, e ele, e a sua casa muitos dias.

verses.original: כַּ֤ד הַקֶּ֙מַח֙ לֹ֣א כָלָ֔תָה וְצַפַּ֥חַת הַשֶּׁ֖מֶן לֹ֣א חָסֵ֑ר כִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר בְּיַ֥ד אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: kaḏ haq·qe·maḥ lō ḵā·lā·ṯāh wə·ṣap·pa·ḥaṯ haš·še·men lō ḥā·sêr kiḏ·ḇar Yah·weh ’ă·šer dib·ber bə·yaḏ ’ê·lî·yā·hū
verses.literal: The jar of flour was not exhausted and the jug of oil did not run dry according to the word that the LORD had spoken through Elijah
verses.literalPt: Da panela a farinha não se acabou, e da botija o azeite não faltou; conforme a palavra do SENHOR, que ele falara pelo ministério de Elias.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י אַחַר֙ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה חָלָ֕ה בֶּן־ הָאִשָּׁ֖ה בַּעֲלַ֣ת הַבָּ֑יִת וַיְהִ֤י חָלְיוֹ֙ חָזָ֣ק מְאֹ֔ד עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ נֽוֹתְרָה־ בּ֖וֹ נְשָׁמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’a·ḥar had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh ḥā·lāh ben- hā·’iš·šāh ba·‘ă·laṯ hab·bā·yiṯ way·hî ḥā·lə·yōw ḥā·zāq mə·’ōḏ ‘aḏ ’ă·šer lō- nō·wṯ·rāh- bōw nə·šā·māh
verses.literal: Later . . . . . . the son of the woman who owned the house . . . became ill and his sickness grew worse and worse until no breath remained in him
verses.literalPt: E depois destas coisas sucedeu que adoeceu o filho desta mulher, dona da casa; e a sua doença se agravou muito, até que nele nenhum fôlego ficou.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ מַה־ לִּ֥י וָלָ֖ךְ אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים בָּ֧אתָ אֵלַ֛י לְהַזְכִּ֥יר אֶת־ עֲוֺנִ֖י וּלְהָמִ֥ית אֶת־ בְּנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer ’el- ’ê·lî·yā·hū mah- lî wā·lāḵ ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm bā·ṯā ’ê·lay lə·haz·kîr ’eṯ- ‘ă·wō·nî ū·lə·hā·mîṯ ’eṯ- bə·nî
verses.literal: O man of God said the woman to Elijah what have you done to me Have you come . . . to remind me of my iniquity and cause the death of my son
verses.literalPt: Então ela disse a Elias: Que tenho eu contigo, homem de Deus? vieste tu a mim para trazeres à memória a minha iniqüidade, e matares a meu filho?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלֶ֖יהָ תְּנִֽי־ לִ֣י אֶת־ בְּנֵ֑ךְ וַיִּקָּחֵ֣הוּ מֵחֵיקָ֗הּ וַֽיַּעֲלֵ֙הוּ֙ אֶל־ הָעֲלִיָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁר־ הוּא֙ יֹשֵׁ֣ב שָׁ֔ם וַיַּשְׁכִּבֵ֖הוּ עַל־ מִטָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·le·hā tə·nî- lî ’eṯ- bə·nêḵ way·yiq·qā·ḥê·hū mê·ḥê·qāh way·ya·‘ă·lê·hū ’el- hā·‘ă·lî·yāh ’ă·šer- hū yō·šêḇ šām way·yaš·ki·ḇê·hū ‘al- miṭ·ṭā·ṯōw
verses.literal: But Elijah said to her Give me your son So he took him from her arms carried him to the upper room where he was staying . . . and laid him on his own bed
verses.literalPt: E ele disse: Dá-me o teu filho. E ele o tomou do seu regaço, e o levou para cima, ao quarto, onde ele mesmo habitava, e o deitou em sua cama,

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔י הֲ֠גַם עַל־ הָאַלְמָנָ֞ה אֲשֶׁר־ אֲנִ֨י מִתְגּוֹרֵ֥ר עִמָּ֛הּ הֲרֵע֖וֹתָ לְהָמִ֥ית אֶת־ בְּנָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ’el- Yah·weh way·yō·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāy hă·ḡam ‘al- hā·’al·mā·nāh ’ă·šer- ’ă·nî miṯ·gō·w·rêr ‘im·māh hă·rê·‘ō·w·ṯā lə·hā·mîṯ ’eṯ- bə·nāh
verses.literal: Then he cried out to the LORD O LORD my God have You also brought tragedy on this widow who has opened her home to me . . . by causing her son to die
verses.literalPt: E clamou ao SENHOR, e disse: Ó SENHOR meu Deus, também até a esta viúva, com quem me hospedo, afligiste, matando-lhe o filho?

verses.original: וַיִּתְמֹדֵ֤ד עַל־ הַיֶּ֙לֶד֙ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ פְּעָמִ֔ים וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔י תָּ֥שָׁב נָ֛א נֶֽפֶשׁ־ הַיֶּ֥לֶד הַזֶּ֖ה עַל־ קִרְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·mō·ḏêḏ ‘al- hay·ye·leḏ šā·lōš pə·‘ā·mîm way·yiq·rā ’el- Yah·weh way·yō·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāy tā·šāḇ nā ne·p̄eš- hay·ye·leḏ haz·zeh ‘al- qir·bōw
verses.literal: Then he stretched himself out over the child three times and cried out to the LORD O LORD my God please let this boy’s life return to him
verses.literalPt: Então se estendeu sobre o menino três vezes, e clamou ao SENHOR, e disse: Ó SENHOR meu Deus, rogo-te que a alma deste menino torne a entrar nele.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה בְּק֣וֹל אֵלִיָּ֑הוּ וַתָּ֧שָׁב נֶֽפֶשׁ־ הַיֶּ֛לֶד עַל־ קִרְבּ֖וֹ וַיֶּֽחִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ Yah·weh bə·qō·wl ’ê·lî·yā·hū wat·tā·šāḇ ne·p̄eš- hay·ye·leḏ ‘al- qir·bōw way·ye·ḥî
verses.literal: And the LORD listened to the voice of Elijah and the child’s life returned to him and he lived
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR ouviu a voz de Elias; e a alma do menino tornou a entrar nele, e reviveu.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח אֵלִיָּ֜הוּ אֶת־ הַיֶּ֗לֶד וַיֹּרִדֵ֤הוּ מִן־ הָעֲלִיָּה֙ הַבַּ֔יְתָה וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֖הוּ לְאִמּ֑וֹ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ רְאִ֖י חַ֥י בְּנֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ’ê·lî·yā·hū ’eṯ- hay·ye·leḏ way·yō·ri·ḏê·hū min- hā·‘ă·lî·yāh hab·bay·ṯāh way·yit·tə·nê·hū lə·’im·mōw way·yō·mer ’ê·lî·yā·hū rə·’î ḥay bə·nêḵ
verses.literal: Then Elijah took the child brought him down from the upper room into the house and gave him to his mother Look your son is alive Elijah declared
verses.literalPt: E Elias tomou o menino, e o trouxe do quarto à casa, e o deu a sua mãe; e disse Elias: Vês aí, teu filho vive.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֤אמֶר הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ אֶל־ אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ עַתָּה֙ זֶ֣ה יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֛י אִ֥ישׁ אֱלֹהִ֖ים אָ֑תָּה וּדְבַר־ יְהוָ֥ה בְּפִ֖יךָ אֱמֶֽת׃פ
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer hā·’iš·šāh ’el- ’ê·lî·yā·hū ‘at·tāh zeh yā·ḏa‘·tî kî ’îš ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’āt·tāh ū·ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh bə·p̄î·ḵā ’ĕ·meṯ
verses.literal: Then the woman said to Elijah Now . . . I know that you are a man of God and that the word of the LORD from your mouth is truth
verses.literalPt: Então a mulher disse a Elias: Nisto conheço agora que tu és homem de Deus, e que a palavra do SENHOR na tua boca é verdade.
